instruct: Warm, friendly female storyteller and teacher narrating for children ages 4 to 8. Speak slowly and very clearly with a cheerful, gentle and encouraging tone. Articulate every word, use playful, expressive intonation, and keep it calm, kind and reassuring.

lines.text: ¿Quieres salir del taller? Toca el botón verde para seguir jugando, o el rojo para salir.
